conviction_note: Day two of a sell-off after the 2026-10-08 08:30 ET preliminary FY2026 release (H2 revenue down y/y on a ceased Middle East contract). The two findings roughly cancel: the open, effective $125m ATM can sell into any Monday bounce (-0.5), and H.C. Wainwright, the Buy-rated broker who is also the ATM agent, published the Monday after last year's October prelim (+0.4, pattern only, no 2026 note found). So impact_sum is -0.1, and with p_up 49 on an abs move of 6.5 the scaled number is -0.13.
bar: unsourced: the 2026-10-08 release gives no prior guidance and I found no consensus for H2 revenue, so every size is capped small. The release itself is https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1859690/000110465926114690/tm2627283d1_ex99-1.htm

cause.label: earnings_miss
cause.what_happened: At 08:30 ET on 2026-10-08 Arqit pre-released FY2026: H2 revenue of about $355-380k against $463k a year earlier, hurt by the end of revenue recognition on a material Middle East contract. FY revenue was $975k-1.0m and cash about $51m. The stock fell 18.3% that day. On 2026-10-09 it opened 4.3% higher and then sold off 13.7% intraday by 15:05 ET on 2.6x volume, with no new filing or release found for today.

evidence.claim: Press release timestamped 8:30 am EDT, Oct 8 2026
H2 revenue ~$355-380k vs $463k; FY $975k-1.0m vs $530k; cash ~$51m; Middle East contract revenue recognition ceased; NATO contract signed 6 Oct; full results due December
No filing dated 2026-10-09; last 6-K accepted 2026-10-09T00:01Z (20:01 ET on 10-08)

pipeline.next_dated_event: Full H2/FY2026 results and conference call, 'December 2026', date not announced. Nothing dated inside the window.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A 6-K or 424B5 prospectus supplement filed on or before 2026-10-12 would make the supply leg concrete. A dated H.C. Wainwright note reiterating Buy on 2026-10-12 would make the repricing leg concrete.

positioning_check: Shares short were 2,439,615 at the 2026-09-15 settlement, 5.8 days to cover, down 6.2% from 2,601,340 at 08-31. This continues a decline from the 3.28m peak at 07-15. FINRA lags about eight business days, so the position carried into the 10-08/10-09 fall is not observable (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/ARQQ/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). I did not source the float. The 25-delta skew is -26 vol points (calls richer) with put/call OI at 0.38, but the ATM spread is 92% of mid, so the skew is too wide to read. The insider selling in the forward block (30 Form 4s, 9 Form 144s, 10-05 to 10-08) is RSU sell-to-cover: for example, Willcocks' Form 144 covers 555 shares from a 10-05 vesting, and COO Wilder sold 218 shares at $24.19. That supply is small and finished.

findings.finding: Arqit has an effective $125m at-the-market programme (Cantor Fitzgerald and H.C. Wainwright, sales agreement dated 2026-01-12) and has drawn on it repeatedly. It can sell stock into any bounce on 2026-10-12.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The ATM needs no new filing to sell on Monday 2026-10-12, because the registration is effective (424B5 of 2026-01-26). The issuer used it in H1 FY26: 846,911 shares for about $18m gross. Cash rose from $28.9m at 2026-03-31 to about $51m at 2026-09-30 against a roughly $4.3m/month operating burn. That is an inference of about $45m raised in H2, consistent with continued ATM use.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No dated ATM-draw reaction can be isolated from the baseline. This name's 95 comparable falls show a median next close of +0.55% and a 53.7% up rate, despite the ATM being in place through 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has absorbed the revenue news but not an issuer that sells into strength. If the market held this, a Monday bounce would be capped. A low share price makes a draw less likely, which is why the finding is small.
findings.independence: The H1 FY26 interim report shows ATM issuance of 846,911 shares for ~$18m: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1859690/000110465926064890/arqq-20260331xex99d3.htm. The cash rise to $51m in the 2026-10-08 release is consistent with further raising: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1859690/000110465926114690/tm2627283d1_ex99-1.htm

findings.finding: H.C. Wainwright (Buy, Scott Buck; also the ATM sales agent) published on Monday 2025-10-13, after the October 2025 preliminary results, raising its target to $60. A repeat note on Monday 2026-10-12 would put a named buyer under a stock that has fallen about 26% in two sessions on a release that also reported FY revenue up ~85%, cash of $51m and a NATO contract.
findings.mechanism_in_window: A broker note before the open on 2026-10-12. The date rests only on last year's pattern (prelim, then a note the next Monday). I found no 2026 note, and if one was published on 10-08/10-09 it is already in the tape.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the October 2025 prelim, reports describe a 20% one-day rebound, the same week as the HCW note (snippet only, the date is not pinned to the note).
findings.why_not_priced: The two-day tape priced the H2 revenue decline and the lost Middle East customer. It has not priced a defence of the positives in the same release (FY revenue nearly doubled, cash up $22m half on half, three Encryption Intelligence contracts recognising from Q1 FY27, NATO award 2026-10-06). If a note were priced, today's open would have held, but it gapped up and faded.
findings.independence: The positive lines are in the primary release: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1859690/000110465926114690/tm2627283d1_ex99-1.htm. No 2026 analyst action was found on any source.

outside_window.finding: Full audited H2/FY2026 results and conference call, 'expected in December 2026', date not announced. The Middle East contract's fate and FY27 Encryption Intelligence revenue resolve there.
Remaining ATM capacity (up to $125m less amounts sold) is a standing overhang over weeks, not one session.

Going-concern, non-reliance and lock-up language: zero recent hits (baseline text probes)

rejected_candidates.candidate: Cluster of 30 Form 4 sales and 9 Form 144s, 2026-10-05 to 10-08, as an insider-selling signal
rejected_candidates.detail: The Form 144 says the shares came from a 10-05 RSU vesting, sold to cover tax (555 shares, $13.4k). The sample Form 4 is 218 shares. These are not discretionary sales, and they finished before the drop.

rejected_candidates.candidate: NATO secure-networking contract signed 2026-10-06 as a new catalyst
rejected_candidates.detail: It was disclosed in the same 10-08 release and is already in the tape. It is folded into the repricing finding as one of the positives a note would defend.

baseline_tension: The findings net to about zero. That agrees with this name's own history (95 comparable falls, median next close +0.55%, 53.7% up) and with the moderate 2.6x volume. It cuts slightly against the cross-section prior (-0.2) and the high-ATR continuation tendency. The call-rich skew is unreadable at a 92% ATM spread.
